skills.description_zh:
锦鲤池/别墅鱼池过滤系统设计工具。

**适用场景**：新建锦鲤池、改造现有过滤、配滤材、选水泵、计算循环流量。

**核心能力**：

- 自动计算：输入池体长×宽×深+鱼数量，秒出过滤仓面积、各仓配比、滤材量、水泵流量、UV 功率
- 仓体设计：四仓法（沉淀→物理→生化→清水）/ 五仓法（30 吨以上大池）
- 滤材选型：毛刷、藤棉、细菌屋、K1 流化床、珊瑚石的用量与摆放
- 设备选型：水泵（流量+扬程）、UV（2-4W/吨）、增氧方案

**方法论**：先算后配，所有建议都有数值依据。

触发词：过滤、滤材、水泵、循环、建池、生化仓、沉淀仓、UV

skills.description: View, filter, and analyze Linux kernel mailing list discussions (local public-inbox archives mirrored from lore.kernel.org). Any of the 353 lists works: lkml, linux-mm, netdev, dri-devel, every driver and architecture subsystem list. Supports bootstrapping and incrementally updating archives, listing discussion threads by time window/subject/keyword, reading individual email bodies, and whole-archive provenance scans (finding "how I found this bug" statements inside patch emails). Trigger words: "lkml discussion", "mailing list", "lore", "community discussion", "who is discussing what", "this email", "find an email", "provenance", "how was this bug found", "mail archive", "lore.kernel.org", "看 lkml 讨论", "邮件列表", "找邮件", "溯源". Archives live in ./lore-archives/pi/<list-name> of the current workspace (install any list with scripts/init_archive.sh); other public-inbox paths can be given explicitly.
